Data.desc:
Now you can complete Jalalabad Gas Payment using upay from JGTDSL Prepaid app. The following areas are covered under Jalalabad Prepaid system:
  • City Housing Estate
  • Dargamhalla,
  • Subidbazar,
  • Mia Fazil Chisht,
  • Pathantula,
  • Bagbari,
  • Lamabazar,
  • Dariapara, 
  • Sheikhghat,
  • Zindabazar,
  • Sobhanighat,
  • Barabazar,
  • Shahi Idgah,
  • Baluchar,
  • Shibganj,
  • Shahjalal Subshahr
  • Majortila.

Payment Journey:

  • Login to JGTDSL Prepaid App using your username and password
  • Click on “Pay” from home screen
  • Check account information. Then input any amount between BDT 250 - 2000 and click on “confirm”
  • Select upay from payment option
  • Enter your upay Account Number
  • Enter OTP for verification
  • Enter your upay PIN and click on confirm
  • Your payment is complete! You will receive payment confirmation notification from upay.
  • After payment through upay, the purchased gas quantity will be automatically added to the meter after a certain period.

Limits and Charges:

  • upay users will not be charged any additional amount for payment from JGTDSL.
  • The minimum bill payment amount is BDT 250 and maximum BDT 2000 for one payment.
